A permissible exposure limit (PEL) is a regulatory limit on the amount or concentration of a substance in the air. In many regulatory frameworks, PELs are set for occupational exposure in the workplace. Specifically, PELs often refer to the maximum amount of a chemical to which a worker can be exposed for a specified time period, usually 8 hours a day, 40 hours a week, without adverse effects.
